name: Stage 31: Åbo to Stavsjö
description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 31, Åbo to Stavsjö.
utilities: Official distance is 11 km from Åbo to Stavsjö. Secondary/OSM-derived sources often show about 9.5-9.6 km because they appear to stop near Stavsjö trafikplats rather than continuing to the old inn/stage-32 start area; use the official 11 km endpoint.

Naturkartan's current route object for Stage 31 is a single 332-vertex MultiLineString from about 58.776197, 16.365988 to 58.724559, 16.417115 and reports 10576 m. OSM relation 3693024 shares the Åbo node with Stage 30 but stops around Stavsjö Klint/E4, so do not use OSM alone for the drawn official finish.

The stage is partly demanding: old forest near Åbo, Åboravinen, high bedrock and steep hills, Uvberget/Uvbergsgrottorna, Björnsjön shelter/beach, Asptorp pump and croft, charcoal-burning remains, E4/Stavsjö Klint services, then the final Stavsjön/old inn approach.

Stavsjö is the practical service and transit end, with Stavsjö Krog & Kafé, Circle K/service shop, customer toilets/water context during opening hours, parking, bus 563/564 context, and lodging around the old inn/Herrgårdsflygel/Kolmården Apartments area. Treat water/toilets as customer/opening-hour dependent.

Åbo access is much weaker: roadside parking where the trail crosses the road, planned larger parking noted by Länsstyrelsen, and at most pre-booked complementary transport context rather than normal hiker-friendly transit.

Björnsjön is the main rest/overnight node with shelter, fireplace, toilet and swim/beach context. Recent reports still support it as a good rest/camp stop, but mention wind exposure, bring-your-own toilet paper, uncertain small-stream water, and earlier litter/overgrowth, so treat it as a rustic lakeside node rather than a maintained bathing place.
waterSources: Åbo spring at 58.775700, 16.366800 is official and matched by OSM nearby. It is a natural source; Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee availability or quality, so treat/filter/boil.

Asptorp pump at 58.745583, 16.377633 is an official pump about 100 m east of the trail/croft and closely matched by OSM. Existence is well supported, but day-of function and quality are not guaranteed.

Do not assume potable water at Björnsjön shelter itself. Björnsjön/Stavsjön lake water is natural water only and should be treated if used; user reports specifically warn that nearby tiny streams can be muddy or unreliable.

Stavsjö Krog/Circle K may provide customer water/toilets during opening hours, but this is not a public trail water facility. Circle K also lists air/water service for vehicles; do not treat that as guaranteed hiker drinking water.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.

Current official warning dated 2024-12-17: Åboravinen is rerouted/avoidance-advised until further notice due bark-beetle-killed spruce and falling-tree risk. Follow the marked/snitslad road detour/red-dot map route and treat older GPX tracks through the ravine as potentially stale; a 2025 hiker report also found parts of the ravine impassable.

Draw the permanent official line, but show a temporary Åboravinen detour/closure overlay. The detour appears to leave near Åbo, follow road via the Sägartorp/Kalvik side, and rejoin near Kalvik/Uvberget; exact temporary geometry should be field/digitization checked.

Åboravinen reserve rules include not damaging living/dead trees or shrubs, not collecting plants/moss/lichens/fungi except berries/edible mushrooms/flowers for personal use, no off-road motor vehicles, and no organized camps/competitions without permission. No blanket one-night small-tent ban was found, but reserve signs and sensitive ground override general assumptions.
The official Uvberget route has harder/easier alternatives. The main Uvberget view is reported limited by regrowth, while a blue-marked spur after the alternatives rejoin gives a better wide view.
Björnsjön shelter is free/first-come and cannot be booked; shelters must be shared if space remains. No bins or firewood should be assumed, and user reports say to bring toilet paper.
No verified public trail bin exists at Åbo, Björnsjön, Asptorp, Halsbråten or Uvberget. Pack out trail waste; settlement waste/recycling in Stavsjö is off-route context only.
Use only prepared fireplaces and check Brandrisk Ute/SMHI/municipal fire bans. Never light fires on bare rock.
The E4/Stavsjö Klint area and the temporary Åboravinen road detour are road/interchange contexts, not quiet forest trail; keep children/dogs close and expect traffic.
Informal small-scale tenting may be possible at Björnsjön under allemansrätten where appropriate, but it is not an official campsite and reserve signs/fire rules override general guidance.
AllTrails and some translated services may render Åbo as Turku; this is Åbo near Stavsjö in Sörmland, not Åbo/Turku in Finland.

facilities.name: Åbo stage start
facilities.description: Official stage start with weak access. Länsstyrelsen says parking is along the road where Sörmlandsleden crosses and larger parking is planned; do not expect a formal large trailhead lot.

facilities.name: Åbo spring
facilities.description: Official natural spring at/near the stage start, matched by OSM nearby. Treat/filter/boil; availability and quality are not guaranteed.

facilities.name: Åbo transit caveat
facilities.description: Do not match the OSM/Sörmlandstrafiken bus stops named Åbo near 58.80585, 16.54179; those are a different Åbo far east of the trail. For this start, normal bus access is weak and complementary traffic must be booked/check-planned.

facilities.name: Åboravinen reroute warning
facilities.description: Active official/Länsstyrelsen warning dated 2024-12-17: the original ravine section is difficult/risky because bark-beetle-killed spruce may fall, and a 2025 hiker report also found parts effectively impassable. Follow the marked/snitslad road detour/red-dot map route until the warning is removed.

facilities.name: Åboravinen temporary road detour
facilities.description: Approximate temporary detour corridor from official red-dot/raster map: leave near Åbo, use road via Sägartorp/Kalvik side, and rejoin near Kalvik/Uvberget. Show as approximate until digitized from official map or field checked.

facilities.name: Åboravinen reserve rules
facilities.description: Do not damage living/dead trees or shrubs; do not collect plants, mosses, lichens or fungi except berries/edible mushrooms/flowers for personal use; off-road motor vehicles are forbidden; organized camps/competitions need permission.

facilities.name: Uvberget route choice
facilities.description: Steep/high bedrock section with harder/easier alternatives. Main Uvberget view is reported limited by regrowth; use marked alternatives and current orange/blue markings.

facilities.name: Uvberget viewpoint spur
facilities.description: Blue-marked spur after the route alternatives rejoin, reported by official stage manager as the better current wide-view point.

facilities.name: Uvbergsgrottorna
facilities.description: Cave/rock feature around the Uvberget area, listed by secondary route sources and mapped in OSM. Optional point of interest, not a facility.

facilities.name: Björnsjön shelter
facilities.description: Official Björnsjön wind shelter; OSM node 1396449029 matches. Free/shared/first-come, cannot be booked, and must be shared if space remains. Reports describe a useful shelter/beach stop but exposed in southerly wind; no firewood or bins should be assumed.

facilities.name: Björnsjön fireplace
facilities.description: Mapped firepit/grill at the shelter area. Use only when current fire rules allow; do not assume firewood.

facilities.name: Björnsjön dry toilet
facilities.description: Dry toilet adjacent/near the shelter, confirmed by official text and OSM. User reports say bring toilet paper; verify condition on arrival.

facilities.name: Björnsjön beach/rest
facilities.description: Official sand-beach/swim context by the shelter. Recent reviews still use it as a rest/camp stop, while 2024 comments reported overgrowth/litter; not a maintained or sampled bathing place.

facilities.name: Björnsjön water caveat
facilities.description: Lake and nearby stream water are not potable facilities. Hiker reports describe muddy/unreliable minor stream water near the shelter; filter/boil/treat lake water only if conditions are acceptable and carry backup from Åbo/Asptorp.

facilities.name: Björnsjön informal overnight caveat
facilities.description: Older hiker reports mention possible small tent spots near the shelter, but no official campsite is listed. Inspect ground/signs on arrival, use allemansrätten carefully, and do not promote this as dependable camping.

facilities.name: Björnsjön no-bin warning
facilities.description: Sörmlandsleden shelters should not be assumed to have trash bins or firewood. Pack out everything from Björnsjön, including cans and food waste.

facilities.name: Björnsjön barrier access
facilities.description: Approximate and limited access: official text says parking may be possible near the road barrier toward Kopparbolstorp, then walk down to the lake and turn north. Needs field verification.

facilities.name: Asptorp pump
facilities.description: Official pump about 100 m east of the trail/croft; OSM matches very closely. Verify function/quality before relying on it.

facilities.name: Asptorp croft
facilities.description: Historic 1700s croft context by the Asptorp pump. Cultural marker rather than a service guarantee.

facilities.name: Halsbråten / stage 31:1 junction
facilities.description: Junction with the 31:1 connector and useful decision point for Stavsjörundan-style routing.

facilities.name: Kolbotten charcoal site
facilities.description: Charcoal hearth/charcoal hut remains mentioned by official text and mapped in OSM before Stavsjö.

facilities.name: Stavsjö E4 crossing / service area
facilities.description: The route crosses the E4 corridor/service-area environment before continuing toward the official finish. Treat this as road/interchange traffic context and keep the map line distinct from quiet forest trail.

facilities.name: Stavsjö Klint services
facilities.description: Stavsjö Krog & Kafé at Stavsjö Trafikplats 2: food/cafe/service area, currently listed as daily 08:00-20:00 with holiday exceptions. Customer toilets/water only; verify same-day hours.

facilities.name: Stavsjö Krog customer toilets
facilities.description: Stavsjö Krog visitor information lists many toilets including an accessible toilet. This is a customer/opening-hours service, not a public trail toilet.

facilities.name: Circle K Stavsjö
facilities.description: Fuel/service-shop context at Stavsjö Klint with customer toilet, food/Pizza Hut, gasol, EV charging and vehicle air/water service. Current station data listed Mon-Fri 05:00-24:00 and Sat-Sun 07:00-24:00, but verify before relying on it.

facilities.name: Stavsjö Klint parking
facilities.description: Parking near Stavsjö Krog/service area. Restaurant parking is for guests; longer parking may require permission, and access/gates should be checked against current signs.

facilities.name: Stavsjö Klint picnic shelter
facilities.description: OSM picnic shelter/rest point close to the route near Stavsjö Klint. Use as weather/rest context only, not an overnight shelter.

facilities.name: Stage 31 official finish continues past E4
facilities.description: Map-quality warning: OSM relation 3693024 and some secondary routes stop around Stavsjö trafikplats/shared Stage 32 OSM node, but the Naturkartan/official line continues along Stavsjön to the old inn/stage-32 start area.

facilities.name: Stavsjö stage end / stage 32 start
facilities.description: Official continuity point at the old inn/hostel/stage-32 start area. Bus, parking and lodging contexts are nearby but should be verified live.

facilities.name: Stavsjö bus stop
facilities.description: Bus stop near the old inn/stage end. Line 563 serves Nyköping-Jönåker-Ålberga-Stavsjö and line 564 links toward Krokek/Kolmården corridor; check live rural schedules.

facilities.name: Stavsjö old inn parking context
facilities.description: Official text says good parking near the old inn/hostel area; exact visitor-use parking should be checked locally. Public parking also exists farther east in Stavsjö and may be better for longer stays depending on signs.

facilities.name: Stavsjö public parking east
facilities.description: Public parking area listed for tourist buses, commuters, carpooling and Sörmlandsleden visitors. It is east/off-route from the stage finish, so show as settlement access context rather than the exact endpoint.

facilities.name: Stavsjö lodging context
facilities.description: Use current lodging names: Stavsjö Herrgårdsflygel and Kolmården Apartments/Stavsjö Kolmården Vandrarhem. Do not treat older STF/vandrarhem references or OSM shelter tagging as public hiker lodging without current booking verification.

facilities.name: Stafsjö Bruksmuseum
facilities.description: Local heritage museum near the Stavsjö finish area. Optional cultural stop, not a trail service.

facilities.name: Stavsjöbadet off-route swim/service
facilities.description: Managed municipal bathing place about 0.8-0.9 km off Stage 31 near Stavsjö, with beach/swim, jetty, toilet, grill/fireplace and parking context. Naturkartan notes Tintomaras väg bus stop is about 500 m away. Verify current bathing-water quality and season.

facilities.name: Stavsjöbadet toilet
facilities.description: Public toilet context for Stavsjöbadet/settlement area, off the Stage 31 line. Seasonal/condition should be checked locally.

facilities.name: Stavsjöbadet parking
facilities.description: Parking for the off-route Stavsjöbadet swim/service area.

facilities.name: Stavsjö settlement waste basket
facilities.description: Off-route settlement waste basket south of the stage end. Do not imply bins at Björnsjön or Åbo; pack out trail waste.

facilities.name: Stavsjö recycling containers
facilities.description: Off-route recycling containers in Stavsjö settlement. Not a trail bin; show only as settlement service context.

facilities.name: Unnamed off-route OSM shelter west of route
facilities.description: OSM-only shelter about 1.2 km west of the mapped Stage 31 line. Not confirmed by Sörmlandsleden; do not promote as dependable overnight shelter.
